role.title: How will you use HEACH?
role.intro: Choose one. You can add another role later from your account.
role.required: Choose how you will use HEACH.
role.unavailable: The role you chose before is not offered at present. Your other details are kept. Choose another role.

details.title: About you
details.intro: We need a few details to set up your account.
details.fullNameHint: As on your ID card. Odia, Hindi or English letters.
details.fullNameInvalid: Enter your name in letters only, up to 100 characters.
details.adult: I confirm I am 18 years or older
details.adultRequired: You must be 18 or older to have an account. A family member can add you and book for you.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: Please read each item and agree to it.
consent.draft: Draft wording, still being reviewed by a lawyer.
consent.terms: I agree to the terms of use
consent.termsSummary: HEACH connects you with independent, verified care providers. It is not for emergencies. You agree to give true information and to use HEACH lawfully.
consent.privacy: I agree to HEACH using my details to run my account
consent.privacySummary: We keep your mobile number, name and choices to run your account. Health records are encrypted and shared only when you choose. You can see, correct or ask us to delete your data.
consent.required: You need to agree to continue.
consent.updatedIntro: Please read and accept the new version to continue.

application.title: Your application

statusText.draft: Your account is ready. To be listed for patients, you will verify your identity and qualifications. These steps are not open yet; we will tell you by SMS when they are.
statusText.submitted: We have your application. We will tell you the result by SMS.
statusText.under_review: Our team is checking your application. We will tell you the result by SMS.
statusText.changes_requested: Our team needs a change to your application. Please contact support to see what is needed.
statusText.approved: You are verified. Patients will be able to book you once your services are listed.
statusText.rejected: Your application was not approved. Please contact support to know why and what you can do.
statusText.suspended: Your provider profile is suspended. Patients cannot book you. Please contact support.

application.reviewTime: After you submit, our team reviews your application within a few working days.

account.title: Your account
account.noUsableRole: None of your roles is offered at present. Your details are kept. To use your account again, including correcting, downloading or deleting your data, add a role below, or sign out.
account.roleUnavailable: Not offered at present. Your details for this role are kept.
account.switched: You are now using HEACH as {role}.
account.addProvider: Also give care as a provider
account.addCare: Also get care for myself or my family
account.addIntro: For your security, we will first send a code to your mobile number.
account.roleAdded: Role added. You can switch to it above.
account.signOutAllHint: Use this if you lost a phone or used a shared device.

reverify.title: Confirm it is you
reverify.intro: We will send a 6-digit code to your mobile number.
reverify.sent: We sent a code to your mobile number.

guard.wrongRole: This page is for another role.
guard.switchHint: Switch role from your account page.

mobileChange.title: Mobile number
mobileChange.intro: Moved to a new number? We will send a code to your current number, then to the new one. Other devices will be signed out.
mobileChange.codeSent: We sent a code to your new number.
mobileChange.done: Your number has changed. Use the new number to sign in.

dataRights.title: Your data
dataRights.exportIntro: Download a copy of the details HEACH keeps about your account.
dataRights.deleteIntro: You can ask us to delete your account and its data. Our team will contact you before anything is deleted.
dataRights.requested: You asked to delete your account on {date}. Our team will contact you.

people.title: People I book for
people.intro: Add family members you book care for. They do not need their own account.
people.empty: You have not added anyone yet.
people.birthYearInvalid: Enter a 4-digit year of birth, not in the future.
people.relationship: Who is this person to you?

team.title: Your team
team.approved: Your team can start lab or clinic work when it opens on HEACH.
team.notApproved: Staff can sign in now. Lab or clinic work opens for them after your application is approved.
team.inviteIntro: We will not send them an SMS. Tell them to sign in to HEACH with this number to see your invitation. It stays open for 7 days.
team.invited: Invitation ready. Ask them to sign in with that number.

staff.title: Your workplace
staff.approved: This workplace is approved on HEACH.
staff.notApproved: This workplace is not approved yet. Your work on HEACH opens after it is.
staff.workLater: Daily work screens (appointments, sample collection) are not open yet. We will tell you when they are.
staff.collectorVerification: As a sample collector, you will also verify your own identity and qualification. These steps are not open yet.
staff.noMembership: You are not part of a team now. Ask the lab or clinic to invite you again.
